name: Sandhya
premise: Rooted and literary. The mark is built from the Bangla letterform অ rather than the Latin 'a', so the identity is native to Bangla and the Latin wordmark is the companion — the reverse of how almost every bilingual brand is put together, and the arrangement your two audiences actually argue for. Colour is a warm ink, close to printing black on uncoated paper, with a single saturated vermilion signal. Vermilion because it is the colour of Bengali print culture and hand-set type, not because it is 'ethnic'; nothing here is folkloric. The register is a small press rather than a software company.

ground.label: Ink
ground.note: A warm near-black. Every surface and every text role is drawn from it, so the whole system reads as one paper stock.

accent.label: Vermilion
accent.note: The only saturated colour in the system. Used sparingly and always meaningfully — a link, a focus ring, one primary action per screen.

declared_duplicates.why: A rejected direction, kept as a record. Same property as Instrument: the line colour resolves to the body text colour in the light themes. Recorded rather than repaired, for the same reason.
